title: coelachyrum indicum
intro: Coelachyrum indicum, commonly known as Indian coelachyrum, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Coelachyrum indicum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and exhibiting antimicrobial properties.
